player_prompt.intro:
I nih hi Player {player_id} ({piece}) ni. Opponent chu ({opp}) a ni.
Move i submit tur chu '[a2 a3]' (atangin → pan) angin.
- Move normal chu a dawttu khum hrang empty a ni.
- A capture chu a dawt tu enemy piece aṭangin a jump a, aṭanga empty node a ni.
Capture aṭanga point {score_per_capture} a hmu.
Game chu {max_moves} move a tlin hnuin a tawp e, ama player ah move dik a neilo tan a.

invalid_move.bad_format: A format a dik lo. '[a2 a3]' hmang rawh.

invalid_move.dest_not_empty: A tumna hmun chu a la reh lo.

outcome.cannot_move: Player {player_id} chu a insawn thei lo.
outcome.move_limit: Hnawh chin chu a thleng ta.
